scope_banner: Opinion measurement among respondents — not a representative poll. 320 self-selected participants.

statements.text: Clean drinking water infrastructure should be a top spending priority.
Public school funding should keep pace with enrollment growth.
Local emergency services need reliable funding regardless of the budget cycle.
Residents deserve clear, plain-language notice before zoning changes.
Traffic impact should be weighed before approving new developments.
Property taxes should be cut even if it reduces public services.
New apartment density downtown is good for the community.
The county should expand bus service even if ridership starts low.
A new sports stadium is worth public subsidy.
Short-term rentals should be tightly restricted in residential areas.
The old mill site should become an arts district, not retail.
Backyard chickens should be allowed in all neighborhoods.
Speed bumps should be added on Elm Street specifically.
